q.en: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I am busy."
q.as: পৰোক্ষ উক্তিলৈ সলনি কৰক: He said, "I am busy."

options.en: He said that he was busy.
options.as: He said that he was busy.

options.en: He said that he is busy.
options.as: He said that he is busy.

options.en: He says that he was busy.
options.as: He says that he was busy.

options.en: He said that I was busy.
options.as: He said that I was busy.

explanation.en: In indirect speech the present tense 'am' changes to the past 'was', and 'I' changes to 'he'.
explanation.as: পৰোক্ষ উক্তিত বৰ্তমান কাল 'am'ৰ পৰা অতীত কাল 'was' হয় আৰু 'I'ৰ পৰা 'he' হয়।
